_comment: Plugin advisor rules. Single source of truth for .claude/hooks/plugin-advisor.mjs (automatic) and the plugin-advisor agent (on demand). Advisory only: nothing here runs a plugin, it only suggests one. Edit freely; each id is shown at most once per session.

fileRules.suggest: Payments code changed: use the stripe:stripe-best-practices skill and skills/ultm8-payments; /stripe:test-cards for test scenarios; run /security-review before the PR.
Schema/migration changed: use supabase:supabase-postgres-best-practices and skills/ultm8-tenant-isolation; confirm every new table has RLS policies and the scoped roles' grants.
Auth/tenancy boundary code changed: run /security-review and check against skills/ultm8-tenant-isolation before the PR.
Sensitive personal data (waivers/medical/files) changed: run /security-review and load skills/ultm8-domain-rules before changing retention or access rules.
render.yaml changed: render:render-blueprints / render:render-env-vars skills apply (the Render plugin also validates the file automatically); after deploying, /render:check-render-status.
Terraform changed: use the terraform plugin / skills/devops-deployment and review a `terraform plan` before anything is applied (deploy.yml runs apply).
Mobile app config changed: run /mobile-check before the next store build (signing, permission texts, leaked keys).
Track B (Expo) code changed: the expo:expo-overview skill routes to the right Expo guidance.
Dependencies changed: run /dep-scan (Dependency Sentinel) or `npm audit` to check for known vulnerabilities and licences.
CI workflow changed: run /security-review (secrets, permissions, untrusted input in workflows).
CLAUDE.md changed: claude-md-management:claude-md-improver can audit it for stale or conflicting rules.
Portal UI changed: design:accessibility-review before the redesign PR (contrast, keyboard, screen reader).

promptRules.suggest: Before the PR: /code-review:code-review (plus /security-review if auth, payments or tenancy code changed).
Deploy work: /render:check-render-status (needs the Render connection) and the render:render-debug skill if a deploy failed.
Committing: review `git diff` first and add a CHANGELOG.md 'Unreleased' entry for any user-visible change.
Security audit: /security-review for code, /dep-scan for dependencies.
Long session or big file: /compact-plan (Context Compactor) or /headroom:peek.
